verdict.rationale: A hands-on keyless GET to the GOV.UK Content API, the layer that hosts Companies House's published guidance, returned HTTP 200 with a JSON body. No bot wall, CAPTCHA or JS-only shell was hit. The registry API's 401 is a structured auth challenge on the data API, not a bot wall on the reading surface. Missing for 10: a direct probe of the HTML guidance pages and the developer-specs guides site with an identified user agent, a probe of a Companies House-specific guidance page rather than the general set-up-business page, and repeated or independent corroboration beyond a single observation.
